about_the_game:
The mind may be split in two, but the goal is one: Unity.

Mind Split is a top-down game blending strategy and puzzle elements, where you control two characters moving in opposite directions—simultaneously. Light can only move in darkness; Shadow can only move in light. The only way to bring these opposing natures together is to grasp the logic of both at once and guide them to meet in the middle.

Each level offers a unique atmosphere: humming forests, abandoned temples, silent deserts… And each environment demands a new strategy, a new solution.

 

Key Features:

·         Inverse Movement Mechanic: Control two characters moving in opposite directions at the same time, and try to find balance.

·         Strategic Editor Mode: Place the given elements beforehand, plan your moves, and then test your solution. But beware—there's no going back...

·         Light & Shadow Dynamics: The Light character can walk only in darkness; the Shadow character only in light. This core contrast is at the heart of every puzzle.

·         Rich Environments & Traps: Breakable floors, shifting traps, and paths shaped by light await your clever thinking.

·         Single-Player, Dual-Control Challenge: Experience the mental challenge of controlling two opposing minds with a single input.

 

Plan. Execute. Balance.

Can Light and Shadow become one again?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: A top-down puzzle game where you discover the harmony of opposites. Control Light and Shadow with a single mind as they move in opposite directions—use strategic moves to bring them together. Balance each step, challenge your mind in every level!
